name: Emberpup at the campfire
notes: Emberpup on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 2) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 2 unlocked it takes seat 2. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 2: down-left, 3: down, 4: down, 5: down-right, 6: down-right, 7: down-right, 8: down-right, 9: down-right). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
